experiment.title: VWR family + IG-AUSTIN-P0 + SPY session-hold (SPY 1m, data to 2026-08-21)
experiment.description: VWR0 baseline and four one-factor variants, the independent provisional Instagram interpretation, and a session-hold benchmark, on identical data, capital, costs and windows. Data ends 2026-08-21.
experiment.dsr_threshold_implied: illustrative independent-trials null approximation: 0.997 annualized Sharpe (expected max of N=7 zero-skill independent trials, T=489 sessions); not a significance threshold or complete DSR

limitations: DATA ENDS 2026-08-21. Every result describes history to that date; nothing here is October-current.
Exploratory: this SPY corpus was already used for VWAP/EMA research in August 2026; no part of it is a holdout for VWAP/EMA ideas.
The latest-six-months window (2026-02-23 to 2026-08-21) overlaps the full sample and the consumed August validation window; it describes recent behaviour and is not out-of-sample.
Chance-max Sharpe is an illustrative independent-trials null approximation (N=7), not a significance threshold or complete DSR; variants are correlated and the corpus was previously explored.
Single instrument (SPY); fixed costs of $0.0135/share/side; 1x notional sizing, so money at risk to the stop varies by trade (see Risk).
VWR touch is a bar-level proxy (bar low vs VWAP at the bar's close); VWR3's 2R target is placed from the signal close, so actual reward/risk at the fill differs from 2.0.
IG-AUSTIN-P0 is a provisional, underlying-only interpretation of an Instagram reel (SPY shares, completed-bar entry), not an exact replication and not a model of the creator's options P&L.
1-minute bars: a stop and a target inside the same minute resolve as the stop (pessimistic), even when the minute opens beyond the target.

experiment.title: VWR family + IG-AUSTIN-P0 + SPY session-hold (SPY 1m, data to 2026-08-21)
experiment.description: VWR0 baseline and four one-factor variants, the independent provisional Instagram interpretation, and a session-hold benchmark, on identical data, capital, costs and windows. Data ends 2026-08-21.
experiment.dsr_threshold_implied: illustrative independent-trials null approximation: 0.997 annualized Sharpe (expected max of N=7 zero-skill independent trials, T=489 sessions); not a significance threshold or complete DSR

variants.label: VWR0 baseline
variants.difference: Baseline, decided from one completed 5m bar with no prior-trend requirement: close > VWAP(hlc3) and low <= VWAP (bar-level touch proxy, VWAP at the bar's close); close > EMA9; bar ends 09:45-15:30 ET; stop at signal-bar extreme (min 5 bps); exit on a later close back through EMA9.
variants.hypothesis: A same-bar VWAP touch-proxy reclaim with EMA9 confirmation precedes continuation in the reclaim direction.
variants.mechanism: Intraday participants defend VWAP; a reclaim with momentum marks the defended side.
variants.primary_metric: Expectancy R (net) with t-stat; daily-equity Sharpe as the portfolio view
variants.uninformative_if: Fewer than 200 closed trades in the full window. (Winner-removal results are fragility diagnostics, not invalidation.)

variants.label: VWR1 no EMA9 confirm
variants.hypothesis: EMA9 confirmation adds nothing beyond VWAP context plus the touch proxy.
variants.mechanism: Without confirmation, more reclaims are taken before momentum resumes; many exit on the next bar.
variants.primary_metric: Delta expectancy R vs VWR0; expectancy of the added trades
variants.uninformative_if: Fewer than 100 trades differ from VWR0 (added + removed + altered); or |delta expectancy R| < 0.03 and both |t-stat of mean R| < 1.

variants.label: VWR2 EMA/VWAP cross entry
variants.difference: Trigger is an EMA9/VWAP cross on the signal bar instead of the touch proxy; context, confirmation, stop and exit unchanged.
variants.hypothesis: The VWAP touch proxy is a better entry event than the EMA/VWAP cross.
variants.mechanism: The cross fires later in a move and less often.
variants.uninformative_if: Either arm has fewer than 100 closed trades.

variants.label: VWR3 signal-close 2R target
variants.difference: Exit at a 2R target placed from the SIGNAL CLOSE (target = close + 2 x (close - stop)), or the stop, or the flatten; no EMA9 exit. Actual reward/risk at the fill is reported per trade.
variants.hypothesis: With the same initial stop, the EMA9-managed exit beats a fixed signal-close 2R target.
variants.mechanism: EMA exits cut losers early and can ride trends; the target caps winners.
variants.primary_metric: Delta expectancy R; win rate; actual reward/risk at fill
variants.uninformative_if: Same-minute stop/target exits exceed 5% of VWR3 trades; or more than 50% of VWR3 trades exit at the session flatten.

variants.label: VWR4 morning entries
variants.difference: Entries only for bars ending 09:45-11:30 ET.
variants.hypothesis: Any VWAP-reclaim effect is concentrated in the morning.
variants.mechanism: Morning range and volume; midday chop removed.
variants.primary_metric: Delta expectancy R; Sharpe on the same capital
variants.uninformative_if: VWR4 has fewer than 100 closed trades.

variants.label: IG-AUSTIN-P0 (provisional, underlying-only)
variants.difference: Separate strategy: 3m bars, VWAP(ohlc4) session, completed EMA9/VWAP cross entry (first bar of session skipped), close-through-EMA9 exit, signal-bar stop. Provisional, underlying-only interpretation of @austin.daytrades' reel on SPY shares; not an exact replication.
variants.hypothesis: The creator's stated chart setup, executed mechanically on SPY shares, is positive after costs.
variants.uninformative_if: Fewer than 100 closed trades. Always uninformative about the creator's options P&L (underlying-only proxy, later entry).

variants.label: SPY session-hold (benchmark)
variants.difference: Benchmark, not a trial: each session buy 99.9% of equity notional at the 09:31 open (09:32 on a run's first session), no stop or target, sell at the calendar flatten (15:55 / 12:55 open). Same capital and costs.
variants.hypothesis: Reference only: what being long SPY during the same regular-session hours earned, net of the same costs.
